input: fresh_result.json regenerated from the trace-64 seed and first complete Hecke frontier
shift_equation: log(Q+jG)=log(Q)+j modulo 4021 for every internal table hit and 1<=j<=3
solve_rule: assign weighted component offsets from checked point identities, solve retained Hecke rows plus anchor on component logs over GF(4021), reconstruct every column log
target_rule: construct the public point from SHA-256 of target seed modulo 4021 before target-dependent work; scan Q+jG for j>=0 until a prepared point matches; subtract j and scalar-replay
coverage_audit: enumerate all 4021 subgroup points separately and record the minimum nonnegative shift to a prepared table point
timing_class: ordinary-host diagnostic, no CPU benchmark tier or paired rho wall-time claim
